info.name: Salon API
info.description: End-to-end collection for the Salon API (internal staff API + public client API). Edit the admin credentials in Auth > Staff login, check barberId/serviceId1/serviceId2 point at real seeded rows, then run the collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner.

item.name: Staff login (admin) - saves staffToken and staffRefreshToken

request.description: Edit the email/password to your bootstrapped admin account, run this once, and every staff request is authenticated.

item.name: Create record - explicit amount - saves recordId
Create record - omit amount, uses default price
Get record by id (nested barber + service)

exec: pm.test("Has nested barber and service", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.barber).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(r.service).to.be.an("object"); });

item.name: Client login (new or returning) - saves clientToken and clientRefreshToken
Client login - same phone, different format and name (original name kept)
Client login - new phone, no name (expect 400)

request.description: Proves the two identity domains cannot be mixed: a valid staff token is rejected on a client route.

item.name: Book second appointment (for cancel flow) - saves appointmentId2
Update status - completed via PUT is blocked (expect 400)

request.description: 'completed' is only reachable through the completion flow, never a generic status update.

item.name: Completion draft on a pending appointment (expect 409)
Complete appointment with a price adjustment
Change status of a completed appointment (expect 409)
Cleanup
item.description: Removes the temp barber and service created during the run so reruns start clean.

item.name: Session logout (runs last)
item.description: Logout requests run after the other collection requests so they do not interrupt authenticated steps.
